changelog: Adds a per-series toggle to series pages in the web client, next to Play. Switching a series off removes every one of its episodes from Next Up and Continue Watching outright - episode number, play state, resume position and the started-watching mark all stop applying to it. Each user has their own list and the server reads the user from the request's own token, so switching a series off never changes what anybody else sees, and because the filtering is server-side the series is gone from those rows on every client, not just the browser it was switched off in. The button is added by a script injected into index.html at request time, so nothing is written into the web folder for a jellyfin-web update to wipe.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
